fixture.generator: same formula as models/mossformer2-se-48k gate golden (ReUseEngine.testSignal), 1 s at 48 kHz

reference.dsp: libdf float32 on the CPU (not model inference)
reference.post_filter: maker formula in float32 on the FP16 enhanced spectrum: in FP16 its 1e-12 epsilon underflows and the maker output is NaN

spec.what: libdf analysis of the fixture padded by one FFT size, wnorm scaled, [1,1,T,481,2]

erb_feat.what: ERB features after the running mean

spec_feat.what: complex features after the running unit norm

long_erb_feat.what: 120 s (fixture tiled): ERB features over 12,002 frames

post_synthetic.what: libdf synthesis of spec x (0.5+0.4 sin(0.013 f + 0.29 t)), trimmed by the delay

df_synthetic.what: maker DF op on spec with coefs 0.3 sin(0.7 k + 0.05 t + 0.11 f + 1.3 c)
